description: Invoice calculator — Exact invoice math in integer cents. Give items= as description|qty|unit_price (add |n for a non-taxable line) separated by ;, plus optional discount= (amount or percent like 10%), tax_rate= percent, shipping=, tax_shipping=yes, paid=, currency=, date= (YYYY-MM-DD, default today) and terms= (net 30, 2/10 net 30, net eom, due on receipt). Returns line amounts, subtotal, discount allocated to taxable lines, tax, total, balance due, due date (weekend flag), early-payment discount with the annualized cost of skipping it, a math check and a markdown table. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_invoice_calc
